items.title: [CISA KEV] Adobe Commerce and Magento - Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-48356
廠商: Adobe
產品: Commerce and Magento
漏洞名稱: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
說明: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-10
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

items.title: [CISA KEV] Google Brotli - Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-111497
廠商: Google
產品: Brotli
漏洞名稱: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
說明: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-10
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products.
